adjudications.finding: 'up to all sorts of doo-daddle in the outside world, I imagine' rendered with 大不了……算是, an 'at most' cap absent from the English
adjudications.ground: pinned chats/tarelion.lua:20-24 - the clause is an appositive elaborating 'the adventuring fare', friendly speculation by Tarelion disguised as a genial old man soliciting library patronage; the cap inverted the stance toward the player

adjudications.finding: 'But what is all th...' breaks off mid-word; the target was a grammatically complete question
adjudications.ground: pinned chats/temporal-rift-start.lua:26-28 - the answer's action calls game:changeLevel(2) and grants the quest, so the speaker is genuinely cut off. But the target's trailing ellipsis already conveys an unfinished utterance, so what is lost is the abruptness of a mid-word break, not the fact of interruption. Form-level, meaning recoverable, advisory per b22-24 and consistent with the b30-39 ruling on the same shape
adjudications.why_applied: a fix round was already required for b31-01
